brand.oneLiner: Plausible is a lightweight, open-source, and privacy-friendly web analytics platform designed as an alternative to Google Analytics.
topicsAllowed: EU data sovereignty and cookie-free compliance
Search Console and SEO performance tracking
Bot filtering and clean traffic data
brand.targetAudience: Website owners, SaaS founders, marketers, and product teams seeking a simple, privacy-compliant alternative to Google Analytics.
brand.visualStyle: Clean, minimal, dashboard-centric interface focused on clear data visualization without visual clutter.
uniqueSellingPoints: No cookies used and fully privacy-compliant, hosted in the EU on European-owned infrastructure
Lightweight and open-source platform with a single-page dashboard requiring no training
Automatic, codeless tracking for scroll depth, file downloads, form completions, and outbound links
Built-in tracking for AI tool traffic (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude) and native Google Search Console integration
proofPoints: Plausible is made and hosted in the EU, powered by European-owned infrastructure.
Plausible's script is 54 times smaller than Google Analytics, saving 135KB of JavaScript per visitor.
Plausible allows you to import your Google Analytics stats.
Plausible does not use cookies, persistent identifiers, or cross-site and cross-device tracking.
Plausible offers a 30-day free trial with no credit card required.
The Starter plan includes 1 site and 3 years of data retention.
The Business plan includes up to 10 sites, 10 team members, 5 years of data retention, custom properties, and a Stats API with 600 requests per hour.
Plausible is an independent, self-funded, bootstrapped, and profitable team of 10 running since 2018.
Plausible tracks and analyzes website visits from AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Gemini.
Plausible provides real-time web analytics to track active traffic, viewed pages, and met goals.
Audience segmentation allows filtering analytics by source, page, location, device, and goals.
Basecamp, Ghost, Hugging Face, Home Assistant, MongoDB, the Python Software Foundation, and Harvard University use Plausible.
Plausible crossed $1 million in annual recurring revenue in 2022.
Plausible is open source under the GNU Affero General Public License Version 3 (AGPLv3).
Funnels support side-by-side comparison across time periods and show total revenue and revenue per visitor at relevant steps.

Squarespace Analytics shows visits, unique visitors over time, viewed pages, traffic sources, search terms, and depending on the plan, form and button conversions, sales, purchase-funnel activity, and abandoned carts.
Squarespace currently states that analytics reports cannot be exported.
When Squarespace analytics cookies are disabled, each pageview counts as its own visit.
Wix Analytics allows downloading analytics reports as CSV files and scheduling report emails delivered as CSV attachments in table view.
Downloading charts as CSV, PNG, or SVG files from Wix requires Analytics Pro.
When the Wix cookie banner is active, Wix Analytics collects data only after a visitor accepts analytics cookies.
Plausible displays visits with an unidentifiable source as Direct / None.
Plausible recognizes some Android app referrals when that information is available.
Plausible provides cookieless web analytics without creating persistent visitor profiles.
Plausible allows recording custom events beyond pageviews, including form submissions, downloads, signups, cart activity, and purchases.
Plausible covers SaaS use cases including signup funnels, marketing attribution through to conversions, custom events and properties, and A/B test result tracking.
Plausible provides privacy-first web analytics without cookies, personal data, or the complexity of Google Analytics.
Plausible can track traffic, campaigns, and conversions across a separate blog or other domains outside of an ecommerce platform.
Shopify Analytics connects traffic to products, orders, and revenue directly inside Shopify.
Shopify Analytics features are available on every Shopify subscription plan.
Shopify Analytics consists of an Overview dashboard, detailed reports, and a Live View.
Shopify Analytics includes default report categories for Acquisition, Behavior, Customers, Finance, Fraud, Inventory, Marketing, Orders, Profit, Retail sales, and Sales.
Shopify Live View displays real-time visitor counts, visitor locations, active actions, and live sales or checkouts.
Shopify defines Total Sales as net sales plus taxes, shipping, and duties.
Shopify defines Net Sales as Gross Sales minus discounts and returns, excluding taxes and shipping fees.
